descriptionByLocale.it:
• Strong negotiation and deal-structuring skills
• Media planning and performance fluency: CPC, CPM, CTR, ROAS, share of shelf, reach/frequency, retail media KPIs
• Advanced PowerPoint and Excel (pricing models, forecasting, scenario planning, pivot tables)
• Pricing and revenue optimization mindset
• Confident presenter to senior stakeholders (CMO/Head of Media/Procurement)
• Good PowerPoint storyteller and deck builder; able to translate data and propositions into clear, visually compelling narratives
• Language: fluency in English and at least one Swiss national language (German, French, or Italian)
• Results-oriented, self-starter with high ownership and resilience
• Client-centric approach
• Strong commercial acumen and analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and evidence-based decisions
• Structured, organized, and able to prioritize across a large book of business
• Test and learn mindset with a balanced hunter drive and farmer-style relationship ability
• High integrity, trust builder, and effective communicator (written and verbal)
• Legal/compliance awareness in advertising and data privacy (GDPR/DSG), brand safety standards

descriptionByLocale.de: Retail Media Sales Manager 100% bei Manor, gelegen in Basel Retail Media Sales, Kanton Basel-Stadt, Schweiz. Manor ist eine der führenden Warenhausgruppen der Schweiz mit einem vielfältigen Angebot in den Bereichen Mode, Beauty, Home, Food und Manora-Restaurants. Diese Stelle bietet die Möglichkeit, in einem dynamischen und kundenorientierten Umfeld zu arbeiten.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Retail Media Sales Manager 100% chez Manor, situé à Basel Retail Media Sales, Canton de Bâle-Ville, Suisse. Manor est l'un des principaux groupes de grands magasins suisses, offrant une large gamme de produits comprenant mode, beauté, maison, alimentation et restaurants Manora. Ce poste offre la possibilité de travailler dans un environnement dynamique et orienté vers le client.
